Container.Name: ClamAV-clamdscan
Container.Overview:
ClamAV-clamdscan is a one-shot filesystem malware scanner for Unraid using ClamAV and clamdscan.
When the container starts it updates the ClamAV virus signatures, starts clamd, scans the configured folder or folders, writes persistent scan logs, and then exits when the scan is complete.
The folder mounted at /scan is read-only by default. View the Docker log for live scan activity and the persistent ClamAV log folder for saved scan results and previous-run history.
Project: https://github.com/bmartino1/clamav-alpine
Container.Requires: Extra Parm are a must for Docker logs and uses. at apply, the scan will start. Wait until Docker stops and use the Unraid web UI to view log on stopped Docker or view logs made in log folder.

Config.Name: Folder to Scan
Config.Description: Host folder to scan. This folder is mounted read-only inside the container at /scan.

Config.Name: ClamAV Signature Database
Config.Description: Persistent storage for ClamAV virus signature databases downloaded by freshclam.

Config.Name: ClamAV Log Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for clamd.log, clamdscan results, detected-file summaries, and previous scan history.

Config.Name: Scan Folders
Config.Description: Container path or paths to scan. Default is /scan. Multiple mounted container paths may be separated by spaces, for example: /scan /scan2

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: ID of the user the application runs as root.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: ID of the group the application runs as root.
